title: Short- and long-term effects of various anti-glaucomatous eye drops on the foveal avascular zone (FAZ)
summary: Determination on the extent of the short- and long-term effects of medicinal intraocular pressure regulation on the blood flow in the center of the retina

interventions.name:
Patients in whom a daily tension profile is carried out under inpatient conditions to evaluate the therapeutic effect. 
The intraocular pressure should be measured every 3 hours for 3 days. This takes into account how many pressure-reducing eye drops are administered daily (0 to 4 active ingredient
Patients in whom glaucoma has been ruled out during the stay serve as a control group

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-Patients older than 21 years Patients' willingness to participate in the study and written informed consent.
-Diagnosis of primary chronic open-angle glaucoma, pseudoexfoliation glaucoma, ocular hypertension requiring treatment or pigment dispersion glaucoma
Exclusion criteria:
Patients with poor general condition or poor compliance
-Patients diagnosed with various eye disorders affecting the macular area
-Patients with an acute angle-closure situation
-Intravenous or oral ingestion of acetazolamide and/or mannitol
